heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
PURSUE Tranche 2 Released — 64 Files Including Senior Intel Officer 'Orbs' Account
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. The Department of War released PURSUE Tranche 2 on May 22 — 64 files (51 videos, 6 PDFs, 7 audio recordings) including a currently serving senior intelligence officer describing 'two large orbs' during a late-2025 helicopter mission, Iranian UAP formation footage, the Lake Huron shoot-down video, transmedium spherical objects near a US submarine, and Apollo 12 crew audio. May 18: NSA released 300+ pages of formerly Top Secret UMBRA records via FOIA — including a 13-fighter-jet scramble account — representing a parallel intelligence-community disclosure track. EO 90-day milestone reached May 20. Combined PURSUE total: 226 files. Next milestone: 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline late Nov/Dec 2026.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
